description: Abstract, geometric forms occupy the center of the composition. A large parallelogram at the left extends into the center of the image. On the righthand side, small rectangular shapes are stacked on top of one another. Soft gray shading appears throughout the image.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
